correctness.rationale: The local update f(a,b,c)=a+c+bc is left-permutive. Distinct inputs with identical cyclic output must travel exclusively in the off-diagonal paired-state graph; its two recurrent SCCs are the claimed even-cycle components, yielding odd-N injectivity and restricting collisions at even N to the alternating-parity support sector U. Direct equations for zero-output parity show F^{-1}(U)=U and F preserves U. Thus the complement is an invariant finite permutation sector of size 2^(2m)-2^(m+1)+1. Inside U successive maps are shifts times (I+S)^t on m-dimensional F_2 cyclic modules; m=q*u with u odd yields (x+1)^q as the only nilpotent factor of x^m-1 and rank m-min(t,q). Intersecting parity-sector images only in zero gives the image formula; nilpotent primary vectors produce exact entrance counts. Koopman rank K^t equals |image F^t|, so first and second rank differences give zero multiplicity and Jordan block frequencies. Independently enumerated every state of ring sizes 3..14 and image ranks; the original package code and off-diagonal graph table were separately inspected. The all-N statement rests on the finite 12-vertex collision graph proof and polynomial factorization, not the bounded experiment.
